visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with two men walking through a hallway, one wearing a black polo shirt and a backwards cap, the other a beige vest over an orange shirt. They pass a sign indicating 'First class/Business class' and enter a brightly lit aircraft cabin. (2) The camera focuses on the interior of the business class cabin, showing leather seats and a large screen. A close-up shows the screen with 'WELCOME ONBOARD' displayed. The man with glasses interacts with the interface. (3) The man in the black cap sits in a reclining seat, smiling broadly. He places a smartphone on a wooden surface, which lights up showing a charging icon. Yellow text overlays appear. (4) A quick exterior cut shows a white and gold STARLUX airplane on a rainy tarmac with engines visible. (5) Back inside, the man with glasses reads a menu with the text 'STAR SELECTED'. The man in the black cap is then shown eating a plated meal containing beef, rice, and vegetables with chopsticks, looking satisfied with high-contrast cinematic lighting on the food.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The interior features modern aircraft business class pods with leather upholstery, wood-grain tables, and large entertainment screens. The exterior background shows a cloudy airport runway.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM begins immediately. A male voice narrates with a bright, energetic tone. (2) A softer female voice briefly explains on-screen features with clear professional articulation. BGM ducks slightly to allow the speech to be prominent. (3) A sharp 'ding' digital notification sound triggers as the phone begins charging on screen. The main male voice shouts excitedly with high arousal. (4) Acoustic shift to a low-frequency hum representing the aircraft's exterior environment during a visual cut to the plane. (5) Transitions back to conversational dialogue inside the cabin. Sounds of eating and paper rustling are mixed in as the narrator describes the meal in a satisfied, rhythmic tone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Arrival -> Feature Showcase -> Experience -> Product Highlight
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase and promote the luxury business class experience of STARLUX Airlines, specifically on the A330neo route to Singapore. It highlights amenities like the touch screen, wireless charging, and gourmet meals created by a famous chef.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly mentions STARLUX Airlines, shows the plane's livery, and provides a detailed review of their business class services and food.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-energy social media vlog format to appeal to younger travelers. The focus on technology and food is a key differentiator.
